body.name: Exact rational-input and real-algebraic-output encoding
body.construction: Encode every rational entry of \(B\), \(H\), and \(Q_1,\ldots,Q_L\) by a signed binary numerator and positive binary denominator. Encode each real-algebraic output coordinate by a square-free integer polynomial and a rational isolating interval; \(\Lambda\) denotes the total rational-input bit length.
